title: Best trombone players
summary: Zue Robertson, Roy Palmer and Kid Ory are named as the best trombonists.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: That's right. Who were some of the best trombonists you ever heard, if you can remember, aside from people

like Ory? Zoo Robson. Zoo Robson. Zoo Robson. Well done, good trombone play. I was done with Zoo Robson. How'd you like Roy? Roy Palmer, good trombone play, but Ory, you know, Ory had that stuff with him. Yeah. Ory too, good trombone play, Ory.
